Face_Skin.method: rowwise contour warp of v10; face outline and baked cheek shade move together
Face_Skin.interpolation: linear row anchors; premultiplied bilinear, y unchanged

Neck.reason: center upper neck beneath corrected jaw, fix collar junction

Neck_Shadow_Chin.method: same deformation as Neck; clip alpha to Neck

Face_Shadow_Hair.method: recompute stationary hair cast shadow against corrected face alpha

Mouth_Skin_Upper.method: refresh skin RGB from corrected Face_Skin; keep existing feature mask/position
